decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree fits the core dairy offer and once exceeded aspiration, but its absence from the website since 2019 suggests fading prominence, so it is kept with moderate risk.
The flagship Abendbrotkäse reflects strategic commitment and uses existing cheese capacity, so slack supports carrying it, although it has not appeared on the website since its launch.
The semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the established offer and cheap to maintain, so no clear shortfall calls for search for other uses of its resources.
The spicy cheese line may lose individual variants, but the line as a whole is likely kept since no failure has been reported.

The niche washed-rind soft cheese resembles the already withdrawn soft cheese E and has had no visible presence for years, which points to a shortfall against aspiration and favours moving its resources to the core business.
